visual.description: Warm coral-salmon blurred gradient that fills the full-bleed hero section, establishing the brand's warm emotional tone.
Warm ivory cream used consistently across all main content and footer sections.
Deep warm dark brown for large display headings and the MAI wordmark.
Warm dark brown for paragraph and body copy throughout the site.
Medium warm gray-brown used for labels, read-time metadata, category captions, and secondary annotations.
Near-white warm cream for headline and body text overlaid on the coral hero background.
Warm beige pill shape for primary CTA buttons like 'MAI Team' and 'Explore careers'.
Muted blue-gray pill for secondary CTA buttons like 'More about MAI', providing subtle cool contrast.
Near-black warm tone used exclusively for the accessibility mode toggle background.
